D5_inner_products.comment: Delsarte dual for spherical codes in S^4 whose distinct inner products lie in {-1,-1/2,0,1/2}. f(1)/f_0 = 42 excludes sizes 43 and 44 in this class. The root-system argument in RESEARCH.md then cuts the same class to 40.

L5_inner_products.comment: Delsarte dual for inner products in {-1,-3/4,-1/2,-1/4,0,1/2}, the exact angle set of Leech's L5. f(1)/f_0 = 239925/5456 < 44 excludes size 44 in this class.
